basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old living in Edmonton, Alberta. I'm a huge fan of collecting vinyl records and enjoy discussing my finds on Reddit. I work as a software developer during the day, and I usually hop on Reddit in the evenings to unwind. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new music and playing online games like AQ3D. I'm not a fan of overly structured communities but appreciate a good set of guidelines to keep things civil.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from the University of Alberta. My love for music led me to start a vinyl collection, and I often share my latest finds and discuss audio equipment on Reddit. I also play games like AQ3D and Typical Colors 2, mostly learning through trial and error and community tips.
